trigger: Player reaches the core elevator shaft requiring alignment tokens in Room 03.

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, elevator bot refused my cash. It asked for 'alignment tokens.' Tragic.

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Fir khende bohota galla kad da. Skip the tokens. I'll rewind the lift.

lines.speaker: brahmansh
lines.text: And I'll Jump Cut through the maintenance hatch. Let's ride.
